titleStmt.title: The American Minister (South) to the Panaman Minister for Foreign Affairs (Arosemena)

div.head: The American Minister (South) to the Panaman Minister for Foreign Affairs (Arosemena)
div.p: Under instructions from my Government, I have the honor to inform Your Excellency that the modifications proposed by you in the regulations governing commercial aviation in the Republic of Panama are acceptable to it as well as the decree enclosed with your Note which Your Excellency states the Panaman Government will now promulgate.
